doc: Machine-readable copy of GUARDRAILS.md. Tiers: free, free_logged, ask_once, pin. Stricter tier wins; unlisted actions are ask_once.

rules.match: read anywhere in work_dirs, training_dir, the Flow repo, project shared files
create or edit files inside work_dirs
calls to the rig's Ollama models
gemini_helper.py research|proofread on non-private, non-clinical text
web search and reading public pages
update task card/issue state and logs, create follow-up cards
restart Worker, Remote Control, watchdog, hub processes
any write under training_dir via training_intake.py
ollama create jarvis-fc*; keep previous build under a dated tag
push to claude/* branches of flanneryjake/Flow, open PRs
delete files Jarvis created in work_dirs or training_dir, backup written first
create/change scheduled tasks, startup entries, services
pip/npm/winget/choco installs, running downloaded code
network, firewall, Tailscale, power, Windows settings
edit files outside work_dirs and training_dir
purchases, subscriptions, paid API tiers, orders
email, social posts, publishing products, messaging people outside the project
delete files Jarvis did not create, >20 files at once, or without backup
keys, tokens, passwords, account and security settings
merge into main of any repository
change GUARDRAILS.md, policy.json or the approval hook

hard_stops: clinical content to Gemini or any outside service
patient/client identifying information in training data
secrets in training data or logs
whole copyrighted books or paywalled articles copied verbatim
